embeds.title: 🎨 Aramaki's Tinfoil Theme Editor is here!
embeds.description: A full visual, in-browser editor for Tinfoil `theme.json` files — no more hand-editing raw JSON and guessing what a field does. Load a theme, tweak colors/logos/backgrounds/audio with real UI controls, preview it live, and export.

fields.name: ✨ Features
fields.value:
• Auto-generates a full editor from any theme.json
• Live 16:9 preview of your actual theme layout
• Logo preview at true size + an in-browser music tester
• Palette generator (10 schemes) + one-click extraction from your background image
• 100% local — nothing ever leaves your browser
